policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_from: Compare the remaining visible candidates with the preference's remaining candidates using updated counters; already deposited cubes need not remain visible. This joint matching distinguishes nearby-bin layouts with different target choices or color orders.
policy_prompt_for_subgoal.modify_to: Compare the currently observable remaining cube arrangement with each preference's remaining candidates and any additional arrangement landmarks, using updated counters. Already deposited cubes and later-revealed or currently occluded cubes need not be visible; an initial scene may show only the first target. Use all available arrangement evidence to distinguish preferences with nearby bins, rather than assigning a layout by bin proximity or assigning a target by whichever reference point is nearest. Visible landmarks help identify the layout but do not override its indexed target. This joint matching distinguishes nearby-bin layouts with different target choices or color orders.

revision.refused: No requested correction is refused. The layout-matching clarification applies uniformly to existing and new preferences. Memory definitions, deposit recognition, quota and held-cube transitions, earlier preferences, and the unmatched-layout fallback remain unchanged.
